title: 1.2% GPM — a clear information guide
description: Understand Lithuania’s 1.2% GPM allocation: FR0512 steps, visual explanations, a calculator, video and official sources for the 2027 campaign.
lead: What this share of income tax means, how to choose a recipient and complete FR0512. Explanations, examples and official sources in one place.
prelaunch: 2027 campaign: applications run from 1 January to 3 May 2027. You can explore the guide now.
unverified: Before submitting, check the recipient with code 301004570 in EDS. The parish’s readiness to receive GPM support in the 2027 campaign is still being confirmed.
openStatus: 2027 campaign: submit the application for 2026 income by 3 May 2027 inclusive.
closedStatus: The initial application deadline for 2026 has passed. Check VMI for amendment rules and future deadlines.

introBody: Allocating income tax through VMI and transferring your own funds are different mechanisms. This guide explains the distinction.
paths: An allocation of Lithuanian personal income tax through VMI. It is not 1.2% of your salary or an additional bank payment.
A bank transfer to the parish account. You can help today, whether or not you take part in the Lithuanian GPM scheme.
calcBody: Enter the annual GPM amount from which support would be allocated, not your salary. This is an illustration, not a VMI tax assessment.
calcNote: The calculation runs only in your browser. Values are not transmitted. VMI determines the actual amount transferred.
calcInvalid: Enter an amount from 0 to 100,000,000 with no more than two decimal places.
guideTitle: Clear, one step at a time.
guideBody: Choose a step to see its explanation and visual guide. This is an instructional illustration, not a real EDS screen.
steps: Open the official VMI Electronic Declaration System and sign in as usual. Do not enter banking passwords or your personal identification code on this information website.
In EDS, select Deklaravimas → Pildyti formą → Prašymas skirti paramą. Complete the application with the electronic wizard.

Find your chosen recipient in EDS by code and check the full name. Bukiškis parish example: 301004570 — Bukiškio stačiatikių Kristaus Gimimo parapija. Check that the recipient is available in the system before submitting.
You may allocate up to 1.2%. For the 2027 campaign, the starting tax year is 2026. The latest end year is 2030: five tax years, 2026–2030 inclusive.
Check the recipient, percentage and years. Submit, then check in EDS that your application has been accepted. If you must file GPM311, meet the deadline set by VMI.
guideNote: This diagram explains the process; it does not reproduce the EDS interface. Check VMI rules and recipient details before submitting.

donateTitle: Bank details for a voluntary donation
donateBody: A voluntary donation can be transferred directly to the parish’s bank account. This website does not accept payments or submit FR0512 applications.
donateNote: Check the beneficiary and IBAN before confirming a transfer. Ask your bank about availability, conditions and fees.
donateSafety: We do not ask for card details, banking passwords or verification codes on this website.
faq: No. FR0512 allocates part of your income tax; it does not debit an additional donation from your bank account. A direct bank transfer in the support section is a separate way to give.
Who can use the GPM scheme?

The scheme concerns Lithuanian personal income tax and VMI eligibility conditions. Your website language, citizenship or residence abroad alone does not establish eligibility. Check your own tax situation with VMI.
Yes. The total allocation for recipients in this category must not exceed 1.2%. How you divide that share is your choice.
I previously chose several years. Must I apply again?
Check your existing allocations in EDS. How older applications will operate after religious communities regain eligibility in 2027 is still being clarified; we do not promise automatic renewal.
Do I need to file GPM311?

If you are required to declare income, file by the deadline set by VMI. FR0512 does not replace the income tax return. Failure to meet declaration requirements may prevent the support from being transferred.
Will this website send my tax details to the parish?
No. There is no tax-data submission form here. Applications are made only in EDS. Calculator values stay in your browser.
How can I help without GPM?
You can make a voluntary bank transfer using the details in the parish-support section. Contact the parish about donating materials or helping with work.
sourcesBody: The instructions are based on VMI guidance. Where information differs, follow the current VMI guidance. This information website is not a tax authority service.
contactBody: We can explain the steps, but will not ask for passwords or access your bank on your behalf.
